in_marathi.name: Dipika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dipika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dipika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' which means 'lamp' or 'light'. This name is often associated with knowledge, wisdom, and the illumination of one's spiritual path. It is also a common name for Hindu goddesses, such as Goddess Lakshmi or Goddess Saraswati, who are depicted holding a lamp or a book.
